findings.claim: Current source admits six foundation capabilities, all for the app channel with session assurance: queries identity.session, identity.scopes, identity.entry and identity.syncCredentials; commands identity.createInitialBond and authority.refreshSnapshot. Router handlers match those six manifest entries.

The earlier empty-v1-contract description is stale as a claim about the entire current API. Its narrower empty-business-contract constraint remains compatible with the six foundation procedures; it does not mean the current API has no procedures.

The policy's two-read-only-identity-procedures snapshot also needs updating: source now includes four queries and two commands. This factual update does not supersede the governing scope: horizontal engineering has resumed and business admission remains deferred. These records do not authorize implementing business procedures.

All six capabilities declare requiredEvidence G2. That is an evidence requirement, not proof of achieved G2; the manifest comment still asks the owner to confirm that bar. No runtime execution or deployed feature coverage is established by these excerpts.
